messages:
Sam (partnerships): Quick heads-up — AstraTech / CloudVendor joint perf run kickoff. Goal: validate perf/W and steady-state throughput for marketplace SKU, plus a kernel-tune window for the ASIC. Proposed timeline: 2 weeks of tuning, 1-day smoke + 1-day soak. Thoughts?
Maya (eng-ml): Scope OK. Which models/seq-lens? will we run both gen and embeddings?
Sam (partnerships): Start with 4k token gen + embedding batch sim. Focus on 8-bit and fp16 quant profiles. Keep gen as primary for perf/W.
Leo (eng-platform): We need a telemetry schema and trace hooks before any runs. Can someone confirm metrics and labels?
Sam (partnerships): Good call. Minimal metrics: p99_latency_ms, throughput_rps, watts, gpu_power_w, kv_hit_rate, tokens_generated. Labels: model, quant, kernel_variant, region, hw_batch_size.
Leo (eng-platform): Draft telemetry snippet below — please sanity-check, we'll add to repo under /partnerships/astra/telemetry.json
Leo (eng-platform): ```
{
  "metrics": ["p99_latency_ms","throughput_rps","watts","gpu_power_w","kv_hit_rate","tokens_generated"],
  "labels": ["model","quant","kernel_variant","region","hw_batch_size","run_id"]
}
```
Priya (product): Timeline note — marketplace listing freeze for joint SKUs is T-10 business days before announce. We should align marketing assets after the smoke run. Also need joint logo/legal approvals from CloudVendor.
Carlos (solutions): For SI validation we should produce a perf-test container + a reference app. Suggested runner: `./perf-run --model gpt-mini --seq 4096 --samples 10k --profile=power` and a docker image tag like `redwood/partners/astra:perf-v1`. I'll repo the perf container and make an image manifest.
Joanna (AstraTech): Joanna here — we can allocate 4 lab blades for the 2-week window. Need the kernel patch access for a limited dev key and the perf container. Also want to try our fw-opt branches (v2 and v3) side-by-side.
Arun (CloudVendor): Arun: happy to support marketplace listing tests. We'll need the final SKU descriptor and estimated sustained throughput numbers for billing projections. Also confirm region (us-west-2) for initial launch.
Leo (eng-platform): Proposed lab slots: Wed 10:00–14:00 PDT (tune start), Thu 09:00–17:00 PDT (smoke + soak). Booking now. Also what's the artifact location for logs/telemetry?
calendar-bot: Meeting created: "AstraTech joint perf kickoff" Wed 10:00 PDT — Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/987654321 — calendar invites sent to participants.
Maya (eng-ml): For artifacting use `s3://redwood-partners/astra/perf-runs/{run_id}/`. We'll ingest with redwood-telemetry v0.3. Example: `rdw-telemetry collect --in-dir ./results --out s3://redwood-partners/astra/perf-runs/4123456789/`
Priya (product): Marketing checklist: 1) embargo signed 2) joint data sheet drafted 3) screenshots + perf graphs in PNG + raw CSV. I'll own draft. Need expected p99 and watts numbers as soon as tuning finishes.
Carlos (solutions): SI validation tasks for me: produce perf container, add smoke tests (latency and power), produce Kubernetes job spec for soak. ETA: container by Tue EOD.
Joanna (AstraTech): We'll provide kernel branches and a dev key by Monday. Also sharing telemetry agent config on our side.
Sam (partnerships): TL;DR / action items: 1) Leo: push telemetry.json to partnership repo (by Mon) 2) Carlos: perf container + job spec (Tue EOD) 3) Maya: ingestion pipeline hook + run_id schema (Mon) 4) Joanna/AstraTech: kernel branches + dev key (Mon) 5) Priya: marketing checklist + embargo flow (track) 6) Arun/CloudVendor: confirm region + SKU metadata (Mon) — I'll follow up with a short doc and a meeting invite. :thumbsup:
